UserWorkspace.title: UserWorkspace
UserWorkspace.description: User workspace preferences and identity document that gates all user subcollections.

userId.description: Firebase Auth UID of the workspace owner.

displayName.description: Display name shown in the signed-in workspace menu.

apiKey.description: Optional personal Gemini API key entered by the user.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when the workspace document was created.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp when the workspace document was last updated.

FavoriteVoice.title: FavoriteVoice
FavoriteVoice.description: A favorited voice saved by a signed-in user.

userId.description: Firebase Auth UID of the owner.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when the voice was favorited.

BurmeseCharacterOverride.title: BurmeseCharacterOverride
BurmeseCharacterOverride.description: User-entered custom character profile name for a specific voice.

userId.description: Firebase Auth UID of the owner.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp when this override was updated.

CastingHistoryItem.title: CastingHistoryItem
CastingHistoryItem.description: Saved AI Casting Director recommendation session.

userId.description: Firebase Auth UID of the owner.

prompt.description: Character description prompt submitted to AI Casting Director.

voiceNames.description: Recommended voice identifiers (bounded to at most 10 items).

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when this casting record was saved.

CharacterTranscript.title: CharacterTranscript
CharacterTranscript.description: User-entered TTS transcript script assigned to a specific voice character.

userId.description: Firebase Auth UID of the owner.

transcript.description: Custom transcript text synthesized by this character voice.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp when this transcript was updated.

VoiceUsageStat.title: VoiceUsageStat
VoiceUsageStat.description: Aggregated playback count and total audio duration consumed per voice for a user.

userId.description: Firebase Auth UID of the owner.

playCount.description: Total number of playback starts for this voice (0 to 1,000,000).

totalSeconds.description: Cumulative audio duration listened in seconds (0 to 8,640,000).

lastPlayedAt.description: Server timestamp of the most recent playback for this voice.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp when this usage record was updated.

/users/{userId}.description: Owner-only user workspace settings and parent document for user subcollections.

/users/{userId}/favorites/{voiceName}.description: Favorited voices belonging to the user.

/users/{userId}/customNames/{voiceName}.description: Custom Burmese character name mappings for the user.

/users/{userId}/characterTranscripts/{vo.description: Per-character custom TTS transcript scripts saved by the user.

/users/{userId}/castingHistory/{castingI.description: Saved AI Casting Director history items for the user.

/users/{userId}/voiceUsage/{voiceName}.description: Per-voice playback count and cumulative audio listening time consumed by the user.
